Plus, Bloomberg News White House & Washington Correspondent Jeff Mason discusses President Trump's reaction to the payrolls report and his announcement that he will allow ranchers to process their own beef.  Finally, Poonam Goyal, Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Analyst for E-Commerce and Retail, breaks down Lululemon's weaker-than-expected earnings report, with shares of the athleisure company falling close to 19% to their lowest level since May 2018. (Source: Bloomberg)
